objectives: Recognise the types of merchants and companies and who represents each one.
Explain which decisions of an OOD need a protocol with notarially certified signatures and content.
Describe the conditions for the transfer of a company share and of a commercial enterprise.
Explain the notarial protest of a bill of exchange.
Explain the form of a special pledge contract.

cards.front: Is a sole trader a legal entity?
cards.back: **No**; the natural person is liable with all personal property ([[tz:56]]).
**1 euro**; each share at least one euro cent ([[tz:117:1]]).

cards.front: Name the types of commercial companies.
cards.back: СД, КД, ООД, АД, КДА, and the company with variable capital ([[tz:64]]).

cards.front: What does the public trust of the Commercial Register mean?
cards.back: Third parties in good faith may rely on entries; facts not entered do not exist for them ([[ztr:10]]).

cards.front: Which OOD decisions need a protocol with notarially certified signatures and content?
cards.back: Admission/expulsion and consent to share transfer; capital; election of manager; acquisition and disposal of real estate, unless the articles provide written form ([[tz:137:4]]).

cards.front: The partners sign a protocol for the sale of the company's shop with simple signatures; the articles say nothing about form. What follows?
cards.back: The decision is **null** ([[tz:137:4|Art. 137(4)]]–[[tz:137:5|(5) ТЗ]]). The notary refuses the deed until a protocol with certified signatures and content exists.

cards.front: Form of a contract for the transfer of a company share?
cards.back: Written with notarial certification of **signatures and content at the same time** ([[tz:129:2]]).

cards.front: Conditions for transferring an OOD share to a third person?
cards.back: Admission by the general meeting and **no unpaid wages and social contributions** ([[tz:129:1]]).

cards.front: Form of a contract for the transfer of a commercial enterprise?
cards.back: Written with notarial certification of **signatures and content at the same time** ([[tz:15:1]]).

cards.front: A procurator brings a draft deed to mortgage the merchant's warehouse. What does the notary check?
cards.back: A **special authorisation** for real estate ([[tz:22:2]]); the procuration alone, even entered in the register, does not allow a sale or an encumbrance of real estate.

cards.front: How does a special pledge arise?
cards.back: By **entry** in the Central Register of Special Pledges on the basis of a pledge contract ([[zoz:2:1]]).

cards.front: Who makes the protest of a bill of exchange?
cards.back: The **notary of the place of payment or acceptance**, at the written request of the holder ([[tz:501]]).

cards.front: A promissory note was due on Friday and was not paid. Until when can the protest be made?
cards.back: On **Monday or Tuesday**: within one of the two working days after the day of payment ([[tz:498]]). A late protest loses the claims against the endorsers and the drawer ([[tz:514|Art. 514]]).

quiz.question: The general meeting of an OOD decided to sell the company's warehouse. The protocol has only simple signatures, and the articles say nothing about form. What is the status of the decision?
options: Null
Valid
Voidable
Valid once entered
quiz.explanation: [[tz:137:4]]: a decision on the disposal of real estate ([[tz:137:1:7|Art. 137(1) item 7]]) needs a protocol with notarial certification of the signatures and the content at the same time, unless the articles provide simple written form; a decision in breach is null ([[tz:137:5|Art. 137(5)]]). Entry cannot cure a null decision.

quiz.question: The sole owner of an EOOD decides to sell the company's office. What form does the decision need?
options: A protocol with certified signature and content
A protocol in simple written form, signed by the owner
A notarial deed of the decision
An oral decision, noted by the manager
quiz.explanation: [[tz:147:2]]: the sole owner decides the matters of the general meeting in the form required for its decisions; for real estate that is the protocol of [[tz:137:4|Art. 137(4)]] with certified signature and content, unless the articles provide written form.

quiz.question: A partner sells her OOD share to her co-partner. What is required?
options: A contract with signature and content certified at the same time
A simple written contract between the two partners, filed with the register
A notarial deed, because the share is a real right
A court decision, because the share changes the capital
quiz.explanation: [[tz:129:1]]: a transfer between partners is free, so no admission decision is needed; [[tz:129:2|Art. 129(2)]] still requires a contract with notarial certification of the signatures and the content at the same time, entered in the Commercial Register.

quiz.question: What prevents the transfer of an OOD share to a third person?
options: Unpaid wages or social contributions of the workers
A bank loan of the company that is not yet repaid
A pending tax audit of the transferring partner
A lease of the company's office with two years left
quiz.explanation: [[tz:129:1]]: a share passes to a third person only if the company has no unpaid wages, compensations and mandatory social contributions of its workers, including those who left in the last three years; the manager and the transferor declare it ([[tz:129:2|Art. 129(2)]]). Loans, audits and leases do not block the transfer.

quiz.question: The articles of an OOD provide simple written form for the decisions of the general meeting. The partners admit a new partner and sign a protocol without a notary. Is the decision valid?
options: Yes; the articles may provide written form for these decisions
No; the admission of a partner always needs a certified protocol
No; the protocol needs at least certified signatures
Yes, but only after the registration officer approves it
quiz.explanation: [[tz:137:4]] requires the certified protocol for the decisions of items 2, 4, 5 (first proposal) and 7 "освен ако в дружествения договор е предвидена писмена форма". When the articles provide written form, simple signatures suffice; the registration officer checks the form against the articles ([[ztr:21]]).

quiz.question: A merchant sells his whole enterprise. Towards whom must he give notice?
options: The creditors and the debtors
Only the employees of the enterprise
Only the tax authority and the register
Nobody; the entry in the register is enough
quiz.explanation: [[tz:15:1]]: the transferor must notify the creditors and the debtors of the transfer; the entry in the register for both parties ([[tz:16|Art. 16]]) does not replace the notice. The transferor stays jointly liable up to the value received ([[tz:15:3|Art. 15(3)]]).

quiz.question: What is the material interest for the fee on the transfer of an enterprise?
options: The book value of the fixed assets for the last quarter
The annual turnover of the enterprise for the last financial year
The share capital of the merchant
The market value of the brand, the stock and the goodwill
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:97:1:2|Art. 97(1) item 2 ЗННД]]: for the transfer of a commercial enterprise the certified material interest is the book value of the fixed assets for the last quarter; turnover, capital and brand are not the base. Since 2016 the content of the contract, which [[tz:15:1]] requires to be certified together with the signatures, costs an ordinary fee ([[znnd:90:2]]).

quiz.question: A procurator wants to mortgage the merchant's building for a loan. Is it allowed?
options: Only with a special authorisation
Yes; a mortgage is within the business
Yes, if the loan is small compared with the assets
Never; a procurator cannot touch real estate
quiz.explanation: [[tz:22:2]]: a procurator may not sell or encumber real estate of the merchant without a special authorisation; with such an authorisation, given in the form of the procuration ([[tz:21:1|Art. 21(1)]]), the mortgage is possible.

quiz.question: A bill of exchange was due on Monday and was not paid. When must the protest be made?
options: On Tuesday or Wednesday
On Monday, the day of payment
Within a month of the due date
At any time before the claim lapses
quiz.explanation: [[tz:498]]: a protest for non-payment of a bill payable on a fixed day is made within one of the two working days after the day of payment; Monday is the due date itself. A holder who misses the term loses the claims against the endorsers and the drawer ([[tz:514|Art. 514]]).

quiz.question: Which notary makes a protest?
options: The notary of the place of payment or acceptance
Any notary in Bulgaria, like for a certification
The notary of the domicile of the holder of the bill
The notary chosen by the drawee of the bill
quiz.explanation: [[tz:501]]: the protest is made at the written request of the holder by the notary of the place of payment or acceptance, not by any notary; the content of the protest follows [[tz:502|Art. 502]].

quiz.question: A share transfer contract is certified in May 2026. What does the registration officer check about debts before the entry?
options: The declarations of the manager and the transferor on unpaid wages
An electronic check at the revenue agency for contributions, from 2026
A certificate of the revenue agency presented by the transferor
Nothing; the notary already checked the debts of the company
quiz.explanation: [[tz:129:2]]: the entry follows the declarations of the manager and the transferor on the approved form that there are no unpaid debts under [[tz:129:1|Art. 129(1)]]. The electronic check by the registration officer at the National Revenue Agency applies from 2 April 2027 (ДВ, бр. 69 от 2026 г.); in May 2026 it does not exist yet.

quiz.question: A creditor of a pledge agreement gives consent to a change. In what form?
options: In writing with a notarially certified signature
Orally, before the manager of the pledgor
By an e-mail to the Central Register of Special Pledges
By a notarial deed with the pledgor
quiz.explanation: [[zoz:2:3]]: every consent of the pledgee is given in writing with a notarially certified signature; the pledge contract itself is written, with certified signatures in the cases of the act ([[zoz:2:2|Art. 2(2)]]).
